This is a methodological paper about quantifying heterogeneity in meta-analyses, not a clinical study on macular hole surgery. Does not address the intervention comparison.
This is a review article describing classification, epidemiology, natural history and treatment of macular holes. Not an RCT comparing surgical techniques.
This is a meta-analysis of RCTs, not an individual RCT itself. The protocol specifies inclusion of RCTs, not systematic reviews or meta-analyses.
This study focuses on the pathogenesis and early stages of idiopathic senile macular holes. It is not an RCT comparing surgical interventions.

This RCT compares two variants of the inverted ILM flap technique (Cover vs Fill), not inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. Additionally, average MH diameter was 397 µm, below the 400 µm threshold for large MHs.
This RCT compares inverted flap technique vs subretinal aspiration technique, not inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. The comparison groups do not match the protocol criteria.
This is a review article discussing the rationale for ILM peeling in macular hole surgery. Not an RCT comparing surgical techniques.

This study compares ILM flat covering (similar to inverted flap technique) vs traditional ILM removal/peeling for giant macular holes. While the randomization status is unclear from the abstract, the comparison matches the protocol (ILM covering/flap vs ILM peeling) for large/giant MHs. Conservative approach suggests including for full-text review.
This RCT compares extended vs standard ILM dissection methods, not inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. The intervention comparison does not match the protocol criteria.
This is an observational prevalence study on epiretinal membranes, not macular holes. Not an RCT and does not address the surgical intervention comparison.
